MEMORANDUMOFMASTERLEASE The undersigned,ARTIFACT STAYS I, LLC, a Delaware limited liability (the "Landlord"), as landlord with a mailing address for notices of 1850 Amsterdam Avenue, New York,NewYork10031,and ARTIFACT STAYS ILESSEE 2,LLC,a Delaware limited liability Landlord (the “Agency"), as tenant, with a mailing address for notices of 1850 Amsterdam Avenue, New York, New York 10031, have entered into a certain Master Lease dated as of July 1st, 2026 (the “Master Lease"). The Master Lease covers a parcel of real estate (the “Land") located at address 634 W. 147th (the “Building") in New York, New York, legally described in Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof, together with any improvements now or hereafter located on the Land (the Land and all of said improvements being sometimes collectively referred to as the *Premises"). The Master Lease provides for the rental of the Premises for a term (the “Term") which shall commence on the date hereof (hereinafter, as the same may be adjusted as hereinafter provided, referred to as the “Commencement Date"), and end on the 32nd anniversary of the Possession Date as defined below (hereinafter, as the same may be adjusted as hereinafter provided, referred to as the “Expiration Date"), unless sooner terminated as provided herein. Tenant shall be entitled to possession of each Building within the Premises upon the issuance of a first temporary certificate of occupancy for such Building within the Premises (the “Possession Date") by and between the Tenant and the Landlord. The Master Lease obligates the Tenant, among other things, to pay rent of subject to and in accordance with Section 4.2 of the Master Lease for the Term. Pursuant to the Master Lease, the Landlord has agreed to improve the Premises in a manner that qualifies for Historic Tax Credits (as defined in the Master Lease) by constructing certain improvements thereon and acquiring and installing certain personal property thereon and therein. Notwithstanding the foregoing, during the term of the Master Lease, there shall be no merger of the Master Lease nor of the leasehold estate created by the Master Lease with the fee estate in the Premises or any part thereof by reason of the fact that the same person or entity may acquire,ownorhold theMasterLease or theleasehold estatecreated thereunder and thefee estate in the Premises. The Master Lease is available for inspection during normal business hours at the office of the Landlord, currently located as indicated above. 1 15217552.2

IN WITNESSWHEREOF,the Landlord and the Tenant have caused thisMemorandum of Master Lease to be executed in their respective names, by their respective duly authorized representatives and to be dated as of the day and year first written above.
